newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $933 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $933 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $933 million in 35 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $562 million in 12 sales, with a $250 million San Diego PFFA issue through Smith Barney topping the list.
On the competitive side, 23 sales totaling $371 million are on the schedule. A Dade County, Fla., School District offering at 1200 EST is the largest.

An additional five sales totaling $365 million are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
